title: Future continuous and future perfect: free practice
titleEs: Futuro continuo y futuro perfecto: práctica libre
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: At eight o'clock tomorrow, I ___ (to take) an exam.
items.explanationEs: En curso a una hora concreta del futuro: will be taking.

items.text: By the time you get here, we ___ (to eat) everything.
items.explanationEs: Antes de que llegues ya habremos terminado: will have + participio (eaten).

items.text: Next month, she ___ (to work) here for twenty years.
items.explanationEs: Cuánto tiempo llevará en un momento del futuro: will have been working (o will have worked).

items.source: He will be travelling next week.
answers: He won't be travelling next week.
He won't be traveling next week.

items.source: They will have finished the work.
answers: Will they have finished the work?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta: will pasa delante del sujeto; have y el participio se quedan detrás.

items.sentence: By Monday I will have wrote the essay.
items.explanationEs: Después de will have, el participio de write: written.
